text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craft. Are you fine with a 1,600m tandem 
run tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Just like the Oka Sho... for 
Umamusume on the Tiara route, it's a 
distance we just can't afford to lose at.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ...Ah~, what should I do? I'm 
already getting nervous.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However... you have no intention of 
yielding, do you? No matter how swiftly I 
may close the gap from behind—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“—With boundless agility, you sprint down 
the path to victory that you forged 
yourself.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet what tomorrow holds remains to be 
seen. Though I can only foresee a future 
where I triumph."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—No way. Tomorrow, tomorrow's me is going 
to greet a future where *I* win.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Same to you! My precious, competitive 
friend.
